The embedded engine resolves domains needed by IP rules with the system DNS; node connections resolve on the node server.
Resolves every name through the node with Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS; the local network cannot see the queries.
Uses the servers, per-domain servers and hosts below.
Answers lookups with addresses in 198.18.0.0/15 (fc00::/18 for IPv6) and restores the name on connect. LAN, time, STUN and push names keep real addresses.
One per line; # starts a comment. Without servers the engine uses its default server over TCP through the node.
name = address; address: IP, tcp://, udp://, tls://, https://, quic:// or system; options: direct, default (up to 4), fallback.
type,domain,server name; matched top to bottom. Types: DOMAIN, DOMAIN-SUFFIX, DOMAIN-KEYWORD, RULE-SET.
domain = address, up to 8 addresses; *.domain matches its subdomains.
Refuses QUIC (HTTP/3) on UDP port 443; traffic falls back to TCP.

Read the user agreement before use
Use on own devices only; HTTPS decryption applies to own traffic, and the root certificate is trusted manually. Never use it to break into systems, steal data or bypass the security of others.
AnixOps Net cannot be used without agreement. Exit and uninstall, or read the agreement again and agree.

Traffic is forwarded on this device only, to the configured servers by the configured rules; it is not visible to us and nothing is collected. No analytics, advertising or crash-reporting SDK; data stays on the device.
The app\'s own record: connects, disconnects, subscription updates and failure reasons; links are reduced to the host. The engine keeps no separate log.
Counted from the connection list every 5 seconds; only host names and byte counts are kept on this device, for 7 days.

Only the domains under Decrypted domains, in plugins and in mappings are decrypted. The root certificate is generated on this device and installed manually; the app never trusts it automatically.
Only the listed domains and the domains of plugins and mappings are decrypted. Wildcards: * and ? (*.example.com excludes example.com); the prefix - excludes a domain.
Marked automatically from the decryption results of this connection. Only domains, counts and reasons are kept, and cleared on disconnect.

Only HTTPS on port 443 is decrypted; HTTP/3 (QUIC) connections to listed domains are refused. Apps that pin certificates or ignore user certificates, and connections to a bare IP address, cannot be decrypted.

Compatible with common plugin formats. An imported plugin stays off until its domains, rules and scripts are reviewed and it is turned on.

Turning this on decrypts the domains below, rewrites requests and responses by the plugin rules and runs its scripts, which can read and change decrypted traffic and access the network. Turn on only plugins from trusted sources.
This plugin decrypts every site (wildcard *), including the traffic of banks, mail and other sensitive sites.
HTTPS decryption shows the plain text inside encrypted connections. Use it only within these limits:
Decrypt only traffic on own devices, or of apps, devices and networks authorised for debugging.
Do not capture or decrypt other people\'s traffic. Obtain the owner\'s consent before connecting another device for capture.
Decrypted content can hold passwords, tokens and personal data and stays on this device. Redact it before export or sharing.
Never use it to break into systems, steal data or get around anyone else\'s security. See section 4 of the user agreement.
Map Local answers requests with local content; Map Remote sends them to another URL. Requires HTTPS decryption.
